variant_basis: IDENTICAL to configs/model/q4km-preprocess-featcache-cpu-sidecar.json -- the sidecar SAEA-SN-DEV1000-PREPROCESS itself used -- except LLAMA_MTMD_FEAT_CACHE_DIR, which points at the @ts2 legacy cache instead of the comparator's slurp-q4km. A separate cache is not a choice: core.model.speech_features.legacy_audio_feature_cache_key is FNV-1a over the ORIGINAL media bytes, so a @ts2 file is a cache miss by construction and must never be written into the root whose entries the sealed DEV-1000 packets were promoted from. -ngl 0 --no-mmproj-offload keeps decoder AND bf16 mmproj in host memory, so this fragment's own GPU offload is zero and port 8080 is never touched.
